selection_reason: The MG1 window profile data contains critical information regarding map storage structures and address/index data, which directly addresses the priority of reducing uncertainty about these specific components. The other options (CTY, PTI, PTP, TYP, CFG) relate to city signatures, point-of-interest indices, path types, vehicle types, or zone configurations respectively, which are less central to the core map storage and routing index integrity than the MG1 window profile.
